answer.text:
Adobe’s total Digital Media segment revenue in fiscal 2024 was **$15,864 million ($15.864 billion)**, up **12% year over year** from $14,216 million in fiscal 2023. The change was $1,648 million, and $1,648 million ÷ $14,216 million ≈ **11.6%**, reported rounded to 12%.

**Source:** Accession 0000796343-25-000004, “Segments,” chunk `839ad4e2-d434-562b-b699-c27185c0972b`.
